apiKeyFile.description:
Sets the admin api key for typesense. Always use this option
instead of {option}`settings.server.api-key` to prevent the key
from being written to the world-readable nix store.

settings.description: Typesense configuration. Refer to [the documentation](https://typesense.org/docs/0.24.1/api/server-configuration.html) for supported values.
